prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Bromine (Br) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a marble quarry of stepped white terraces, cut blocks and a still green pool at the bottom
Weather / season: autumn — falling leaves and warm low light outside.
Time of day: early morning — low clean light, long soft shadows.
Outfit: an angel-and-devil party costume — a red satin mini dress with a small horn headband and a tail prop, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: kneeling on one knee, the other foot planted flat in front of her.
COMPOSITION: a full-body shot, her complete head, hands and feet inside the frame with restrained margins; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; head tilted slightly; camera slightly above, looking down at her; she is placed in the left third of the frame, open space of the place to her right; a soft out-of-focus object of the place sits in the near foreground at one edge of the frame.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand is planted on the ground beside her.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a small heavy stoppered glass vial of red-brown liquid breathing an orange-red wisp at chest height; it is all she holds.
GAZE: her eyes rest on what she holds.
EXPRESSION: level lowered brow, steady unblinking eyes, mouth closed in a straight line, jaw set.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — bromine: the only nonmetal that is liquid at room temperature, a heavy red-brown liquid that breathes off orange-red fumes; named from the Greek for 'stench' after Antoine-Jérôme Balard drew it from the bitter brine left in the salt marshes of Montpellier in 1826; the bromine inside the molecule of Tyrian purple, the royal dye wrung from murex sea snails; silver bromide in the gelatin dry plates that caught the light of photographs; flame retardants that smother fire; lavish, decadent, dangerous to breathe — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
